description: The bar chart illustrates the percentage point difference in performance between mBERT and XLM-R across four different model configurations, with the y-axis representing the "% point difference" ranging from -0.2 to 0.2. The x-axis displays four distinct configurations: "hidden:[50], linear", "hidden:[], linear", "hidden:[100], ReLU", and "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU". For each configuration, two bars are shown: a light blue bar representing mBERT and a dark blue bar representing XLM-R. In the "hidden:[50], linear" configuration, mBERT shows a negative difference of approximately -0.17, while XLM-R shows a negative difference of about -0.07. In the "hidden:[], linear" configuration, mBERT has a positive difference of around 0.08, and XLM-R has a positive difference of about 0.21. For the "hidden:[100], ReLU" configuration, mBERT has a negative difference of approximately -0.11, and XLM-R has a positive difference of about 0.03. In the "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU" configuration, mBERT shows a negative difference of around -0.16, and XLM-R shows a negative difference of about -0.12. The legend in the top right corner identifies the light blue bars as mBERT and the dark blue bars as XLM-R.
